transcript: We got some more national tour news today with oh Mary announcing it is doing a national tour now. Right now we just have a list of city stops that they're going to, with the possibility that they could add more. I imagine we start getting a hard date starting tomorrow when Boston announces their national tour season. The stop I'm definitely most interested in, though, is, of course, the Washington, D C. Stop. Are you kidding me? Please. I absolutely love when plays go out on national tour. We've seen this recently with shows like life of Pi and Stereophonic, but this has happened throughout the years sporadically with shows like warhorse and Curious incident of the dog in the night. But I love that unlike most of those, oh Mary is an unabashed, fun comedy. Ah, I. I think this could potentially tour really well. I'm excited for more audiences to see the insanity that is Cole escola’s oh Mary! And I cannot wait to see what theatre this is playing in the D C. Area. I'm obsessed. I'm obsessed.
